title: The Talos Principle
provenance: Reported by barredespace (highball-db#1189, 2026-11-13), Apple M6, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 26 minutes: the player couldn't get the game onto their external display. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Croteam's 2014 puzzle game. Reported playable on an Apple M6 with DXMT on the default engine (r28) over 26 minutes, except that the player couldn't get it onto their external display. Steam lists a Mac version as well.

knownIssues.symptom: The game wouldn't show on an external display (Apple M6, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#1189)
